subject: Onboarding exception request — ZenCrate PO deferment
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@zencrate.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: ZenCrate Procurement <procurement@zencrate.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary PO deferment for trial onboarding

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Thanks again for the smooth intro call this morning. We are excited to start the 60-day trial but hit a snag on our side: our finance team requires a PO to process any vendor invoices, and their procurement system will not issue a PO for pilot engagements under $25k without an SOW attached. Our procurement lead has suggested two options that would speed things up on our end:

- ZenCrate self-billing (we can generate a single invoice at the end of the pilot)
- Temporary PO deferment for pilot period with additional evidence (KYC + signed SOW + PO waiver form)

Is Redwood able to accept a temporary PO deferment while we complete internal approvals? If yes, what evidence do you need from us to get vendor setup and billing started? We can provide KYC, proof of insurance, and a signed SOW this week.

Attached: zencrate-kickoff-sow.pdf (draft)

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can coordinate with our CFO.

Best,
Lina Torres
Head of Partnerships | ZenCrate
phone: +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@zencrate.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO deferment for trial onboarding

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear write-up and for the SOW. Short answer: we can make an exception for pilots, but we need a concrete evidence bundle and a records retention commitment from ZenCrate. Proposed minimal requirements to progress vendor setup without a PO: 

1) Signed SOW (finalized) — we received the draft, please send the signed version.
2) KYC package (W-9 or local equivalent, proof of insurance, business registration) — a single zip is fine.
3) PO deferment form (we have a one-page template) signed by your finance lead acknowledging that invoicing during the pilot is on invoice-only terms and that a formal PO will be provided if the engagement converts.
4) Billing cadence: one consolidated invoice at the end of the pilot (Net 30) OR monthly invoices if you prefer.

If you can deliver items 1–3 and the DocuSign link is completed, I can push this through our vendor intake and billing team as a temporary onboarding exception. Karthik — can you confirm the internal approval path and whether we need a counter-signed waiver in Procurement?

Lina: I’ll copy the DocuSign PO-waiver when Marissa confirms the procurement side.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary PO deferment for trial onboarding

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding ZenCrate's request. Key points: they need vendor setup to invoice us for a 60-day pilot; procurement at Redwood normally requires PO for vendor onboarding but we occasionally approve temporary exceptions for pilots under documented guardrails. My recommendation: approve a temporary PO deferment conditioned on the evidence bundle and a signed PO-deferment form.

Questions for procurement:
- Karthik, do we require an internal procurement sign-off signature on our one-page waiver, or is a vendor-signed acknowledgement sufficient for the vendor intake record?
- Marissa, assuming you sign off, can finance accept a single consolidated invoice at pilot end with Net 30 payment to avoid monthly invoice churn?

Background/context for approval box: pilot spend estimate is $6,000 over 60 days (clearly below threshold). Risk profile: low (SaaS subscription, standard DPA in place).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@zencrate.io>, ZenCrate Procurement <procurement@zencrate.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO deferment for trial onboarding

Hi Lina — thanks for sending the draft SOW and for laying out the options. We can approve a temporary PO deferment for the duration of the 60-day pilot under these conditions (please confirm):

1) ZenCrate returns a signed SOW (final) and completes the KYC bundle in a single upload (vendor-kbv-kyc.zip).
2) ZenCrate signs our PO Deferment Acknowledgement (I attached the DocuSign link). This is a one-page acknowledgment and is not a procurement waiver long-term — it simply documents that Redwood will accept invoice-only billing for the pilot period.
3) ZenCrate agrees to a single consolidated invoice at pilot completion (Net 30). If you prefer monthly invoices, let us know and Finance will set expectations, but consolidated end-of-pilot invoicing keeps the intake simpler.
4) ZenCrate confirms they will supply COI (certificate of insurance) and remit to procurement@redwood-inference.com.

Once those items are in our vendor intake record, Procurement will mark ZenCrate as 'pilot-exception: invoice-only' and Finance will process the first invoice at the end of the pilot. This exception does not change our standard PO policy for renewals or scale.

Action items for ZenCrate (ETA 48 hours): signed SOW, KYC zip, signed DocuSign PO deferment. I also attached the PO Deferment template as a link in the DocuSign flow.

Lina — happy to jump on a quick 15-min call if you'd like to walk through the form.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: docusign-po-waiver-link.html
